rounds.name: Skagerrak Strait
rounds.fact: The Skagerrak is a strait running between the southeast coast of Norway, the Bohuslän coast of Sweden and the Jutland peninsula of Denmark.

rounds.name: Strait of Magellan
rounds.fact: The Strait of Magellan is a navigable sea route in southern Chile separating mainland South America to the north and Tierra del Fuego to the south.

rounds.name: Torres Strait
rounds.fact: Torres Strait is a strait which lies between Australia and the Melanesian island of New Guinea.

rounds.name: Gulf of Oman
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Oman connects the Arabian Sea with the Strait of Hormuz, running along the coast of Oman, the UAE, and Iran.

rounds.name: Chesapeake Bay
rounds.fact: Chesapeake Bay is an estuary in the Mid-Atlantic region of the United States surrounded by Maryland and Virginia.
